input: Call a plumber about the leaking bathroom faucet

gold.taskTitle: Call a Plumber About the Leaking Bathroom Faucet
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to contact a plumber to address a leaking bathroom faucet in their home.

questions.title: Which bathroom has the leaking faucet?
questions.description: Identify the specific bathroom location, e.g. master bath, guest bath, upstairs.

questions.title: Do you already have a plumber in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preferred or previously used plumber to call.

questions.title: How urgent is the leak right now?
questions.description: Assess severity, e.g. slow drip, steady stream, or causing water damage.

questions.title: Is this a rental or a property you own?
questions.description: Clarify ownership to determine whether a landlord or property manager needs to be involved.

questions.title: What is your budget range for the repair?
questions.description: Understand any financial constraints that might affect which plumber to choose.

questions.title: When do you want the plumber to come?
questions.description: Establish a target date or timeframe for the repair appointment.

questions.title: Have you already tried any fixes yourself?
questions.description: Find out if any DIY attempts have been made, which may affect what the plumber needs to know.
